tools.name: directory.get
tools.description: The directory envelope (v0.2, authority: manifest). Real entries only — a data source enters on one of three admission routes (E21); an empty list is the honest state, never padded.

tools.name: facts.badge
tools.description: shields.io endpoint JSON for one subject, derived from the fact table — «no facts» in grey when nothing is recorded, never rounded up.

tools.name: facts.latest
tools.description: Latest effective facts per subject+metric from the versioned fact table — the bitemporal as_of cutoff is exposed; an absent store is the honest empty view.

tools.name: fedlex.check_in_force
tools.description: Check whether an act was in force on a date; false is a valid answer, never an error: use for «gilt das noch?» questions. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.check_quote
tools.description: Check a quote (Zitat) against the norm text of one element: use before citing, to prove the wording is in what was read (Belegkette). norm.

tools.name: fedlex.cite
tools.description: Cite an element as its canonical Fundstelle («Art. 7 Abs. 1 Bst. b LSV») from eli_version and eId: use to label a read place in the Belegkette. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.compare_versions
tools.description: Compare an element or every article between two Fassungen of an act — added, removed, changed paragraphs with wording: use for «was hat sich geändert?». norm.

tools.name: fedlex.detect_foreign_content
tools.description: Detect what the text tools hide in a Fassung: sections in another language (xml:lang) and <foreign> islands (formulas, graphics): use before quoting. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.explore_node
tools.description: Explore a JOLux node's edges (predicates and neighbours, both directions, capped): use to debug what the graph holds about an IRI; never as proof. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.extract_tables
tools.description: Extract the tables of a consolidation or of one element (annex limit values, tariffs) as header and rows: use when a norm is a table, not prose. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.find_related_topic
tools.description: Find acts in the same field of law via the legal taxonomy, by ELI or SR: use to discover neighbouring Erlasse; candidates only. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.find_treaties
tools.description: Find treaty processes (Staatsverträge) by a title word, partner country IRI or bilaterality: use to locate a treaty before get_treaty_info. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.get_article_history
tools.description: Trace which amendments and consolidations changed one Artikel (eId) of an act, with dates: use for «seit wann gilt Art. X so?». norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_citations
tools.description: List an act's relations: cites|cited_by (formal citations, act level) or in|out (foreseen impacts, mostly consultation drafts): use to see who cites X. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_consultation_documents
tools.description: List the position statements and result reports of one consultation IRI: use after get_consultations to read the genesis record. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_consultations
tools.description: List the consultations (Vernehmlassungen) of an act's drafts or of one draft, with status and dates: use for the genesis, never for law in force. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.get_drafts
tools.description: List the legislative drafts (Entwürfe, eli/proj) an act came from, with the Curia Vista number: use as the entry to consultations and materials. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_fga_documents
tools.description: List the Federal Gazette (BBl) documents of an act's genesis — Botschaft, reports — with genre and date: use for materials, never for law in force. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_law_metadata
tools.description: Read the JOLux profile of an act (titles de/fr/it, status, dates, identifier) for an ELI: use to confirm a search hit before you cite. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_memorial
tools.description: List the AS/BBl issue (memorial) an oc publication appeared in and the acts of that issue: use after get_oc_act to locate the volume. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_modifications
tools.description: List the amendment notes («Fassung gemäss …», AS refs) per element of a consolidation: use for «wann und wodurch wurde Art. X geändert?». norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_oc_act
tools.description: Resolve an act's binding AS/RO publication (oc ELI, date, genre, office, memorial) from its consolidation ELI: use to cite the Amtliche Sammlung. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_references
tools.description: List the references (Verweise) an act's text makes, with ELI where linked, optionally within one eId: use to follow cross-references. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.get_structure
tools.description: Outline one consolidation (sections, articles with eId, num and heading): use when you know the act but not the article number. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_subdivisions
tools.description: List the subdivisions JOLux knows for an act (amended elements only, a gap catalogue): use to see which Artikel carry amendments; outline: get_structure. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_taxonomy
tools.description: Classify an act in the systematic collection (SR branch chain, notation, labels de/fr/it): use for «zu welchem Rechtsgebiet gehört X?». norm.

tools.name: fedlex.get_treaty_info
tools.description: Read a treaty process profile (title, signature, bilateral, partner countries, approving decree) for an eli/treaty IRI: use after find_treaties. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.list_annexes
tools.description: List the annexes (Anhänge) of a consolidation with titles and path eIds (annex_u1/…): use before reading an Anhang with read_article. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.list_expressions
tools.description: List the language versions and manifestations (XML, PDF) of one consolidation: use before reading to see whether a Fassung is PDF-only. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.list_versions
tools.description: List every dated consolidation (Fassung) of an act, future ones included: use to pick the eli_version the reading tools need. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.parse_reference
tools.description: Parse a citation («Art. 7 Abs. 1 lit. b LSV») into act, article eId and path proposal: use to turn a quoted Fundstelle into what read_article can open. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.read_article
tools.description: Read one element (Artikel, Absatz, Anhang) of a dated consolidation by eId, e.g. art_6 or annex_u1/lvl_u1: use to quote a norm. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.read_document
tools.description: Read a whole small act or Verordnung as capped Markdown (truncated flag, continuation offset): use for short acts; quote via read_article. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.resolve_consolidation_at
tools.description: Resolve which consolidation (Fassung) of an act governed on an ISO date: use before reading text for a past or future Stichtag. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.resolve_sr
tools.description: Resolve an SR number (e.g. 832.10) to the act's ELI, titles and in-force status: use when a question names an SR; predecessors stay visible. norm.

tools.name: fedlex.resolve_vocabulary_label
tools.description: Look up a Fedlex vocabulary term (enforcement-status, language, …) by label or IRI: use to decode a coded value from another answer. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.search_law
tools.description: Search acts by title keyword or official abbreviation (KVG, StPO, OR): use when you know the name but not the SR or ELI; in-force acts rank first. hint.

tools.name: fedlex.search_text
tools.description: Find where a word occurs inside ONE consolidation (hits with eId and Artikel): use before read_article when the article is unknown. hint.

tools.name: i14y.api_status
tools.description: Check whether the I14Y catalogue answers, register by register, so «no data» and «source down» stay apart: use before retrying a failed call. norm.

tools.name: i14y.get_concept
tools.description: Show one concept's record — type, value type, version, validity (Konzept, Codeliste): use before reading a code list's entries. norm.

tools.name: i14y.get_data_service
tools.description: Show one registered interface's record — endpoints, OpenAPI links, licence, served datasets (API, Endpunkt): use to reach the service. norm.

tools.name: i14y.get_dataset
tools.description: Show one dataset's full record — contact, coverage, every distribution with its licence and download address (Lizenz, Download): use before reuse. norm.

tools.name: i14y.get_dataset_distributions
tools.description: List a dataset's distributions — format, licence, download and access address (Datei, Lizenz, Format): use for «where do I get the data». norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_catalogs
tools.description: List the catalogues that feed I14Y, each one body's collection (Katalog, opendata.swiss, Bundesamt): use to see who contributes. norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_concepts
tools.description: List the harmonised concepts and code lists of the administration (Konzept, Codeliste, Nomenklatur, Merkmal): use to find a code list by publisher. norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_data_services
tools.description: List the registered machine interfaces of Swiss public bodies with their endpoints (API, Schnittstelle, Datendienst): use before building a scraper. norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_datasets
tools.description: List the registered datasets, paged, with publisher, themes and access right (Datensätze, Metadaten, Open Data): use for a census or a publisher's list. norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_public_services
tools.description: List the registered public services with their channels (Behördenleistung, Dienstleistung, Verwaltung): use for what an authority offers citizens. norm.

tools.name: i14y.list_publishers
tools.description: List the bodies that publish into I14Y with identifier and Swiss UID (Herausgeber, Bundesamt, Kanton, UID): use to find a publisher's code for a filter. norm.

tools.name: i14y.search_catalog
tools.description: Search the national data catalogue I14Y by words (Datensatz, Schnittstelle, API, Behördenleistung, Codeliste): use first, to find who publishes what. hint.

tools.name: i14y.search_codelist_entries
tools.description: List the codes of one code-list concept, paged, with names and validity (Code, Codeliste, Kanton, Geschlecht, Nomenklatur): use to resolve official codes. norm.

tools.name: lindas.describe
tools.description: Show everything the holding says about one IRI (a cube, an observation, a Kanton): use to follow an address you were handed. norm.

tools.name: lindas.describe_cube
tools.description: Show a cube's declared dimensions and profile — the record may carry more: use to learn the filters a question needs. norm.

tools.name: lindas.dimension_values
tools.description: List the values one dimension takes (Kantone, Abstimmungstypen, Geschäftsstände): use to filter by IRI instead of by text. hint.

tools.name: lindas.find_cube
tools.description: Find the cube behind a question by a word of its name («Volksinitiative», «Petition», «Parteienregister»): use before reading rows. hint.

tools.name: lindas.list_cubes
tools.description: List the 44 political data cubes of the Confederation (Abstimmungen, Wahlen, Bundesrat, Interessenbindungen): use to see what data exists. norm.

tools.name: lindas.list_versions
tools.description: List the versions of a cube family (Nationalratswahl 2019/2023/2027): use before reading a year; nothing links old to new. norm.

tools.name: lindas.observations
tools.description: Read a cube's rows with filters (Abstimmung, Referendum, Volksinitiative, Ständemehr, Kanton, Datum): use for the figures themselves. norm.

tools.name: lindas.resolve_label
tools.description: Resolve an IRI to its label in one language with a fallback (Kanton, Partei, Gremium, Interessenbindung): use to name a value. hint.

tools.name: manifest.get
tools.description: One entry's manifest by slug. While no entries exist the honest answer is a not-found error carrying the E21 admission rule.

tools.name: meta.capabilities
tools.description: The platform capability register with published per-client coverage — tool names on this server ARE the capability ids.

tools.name: meta.schemas
tools.description: Stage two of two-stage discovery: the full input schemas of the named tools, byte-identical to what tools/list carries, because both are read from the same router. An unknown id is refused by name rather than silently dropped.

tools.name: meta.tools
tools.description: Stage one of two-stage discovery: every mounted tool with its capability id, domain, one-line summary and budget weight — and NO input schemas. Ask this first to learn what exists, then pull the schemas of the few tools you intend to call (meta.schemas). Context economy as a capability, not a client

tools.name: publish.info
tools.description: The publishing path — the only way into the directory: the three E21/E13 routes plus the honest interim state.

tools.name: standard.artifacts
tools.description: The manifest standard's sealed artifact register: path, canonical IRI, draft/published status and SHA-256 per contract file.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "meta.schemas" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Stage two of two-stage discovery: the full input schemas of the named tools, byte-identical to what tools/list carries, because both are read from the same rout…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fedlex.get_memorial, i14y.list_catalogs · Private data: fedlex.get_consultation_documents, fedlex.get_fga_documents, fedlex.read_document, i14y.get_concept, i14y.get_data_service, i14y.get_dataset, lindas.describe_cube, standard.artifacts · Public sink: i14y.list_publishers, publish.info · Destructive: i14y.get_dataset_distributions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fedlex.get_memorial, i14y.list_catalogs · Private data: fedlex.get_consultation_documents, fedlex.get_fga_documents, fedlex.read_document, i14y.get_concept, i14y.get_data_service, i14y.get_dataset, lindas.describe_cube, standard.artifacts · Public sink: i14y.list_publishers, publish.info · Destructive: i14y.get_dataset_distributions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
